description: This source file implements the Monitor plugin component within the WPEFramework, including registration of API endpoints, property retrieval, and event signaling related to plugin monitoring (e.g., restart limits, statistics reset, and status reports).

classes.name: Monitor
classes.description: The Monitor class manages plugin monitoring functionalities including registration, status reporting, and event signaling.

methods.name: void RegisterAll()
methods.description: Registers the monitoring API endpoints and property accessors.

methods.name: uint32_t endpoint_restartlimits(const RestartlimitsParamsData & params)
methods.description: Sets restart limits for a plugin based on provided parameters.

methods.name: uint32_t endpoint_resetstats(const ResetstatsParamsData & params,InfoInfo & response)
methods.description: Resets memory and process statistics for a specific plugin.

methods.name: uint32_t get_status(const string & index,Core::JSON::ArrayType<InfoInfo> & response) const
methods.description: Retrieves the current status, such as memory and process statistics, for a specific plugin or all plugins.

methods.name: void event_action(const string & callsign,const string & action,const string & reason)
methods.description: Signals an action taken by the monitor for a specific plugin, such as restarting or other management actions.
